latestVersion.changelog:
🎉 Initial release of gitcode-pr-audit

- Provides quality audit for merged GitCode PRs across multiple repositories.
- Samples PRs by time range or PR list, analyzes 8 key compliance dimensions (labels, comments, tests, size, etc.).
- Outputs results as a Markdown or CSV table; command-line tool, Python 3.7+ stdlib only.
- Flexible parameter parsing, with robust multi-repo and branch support.
- Requires GITCODE_TOKEN for authentication; supports Linux/macOS/Windows.
